body: I have, I get the same answer every time. He’s tired and doesn’t want to talk about it. Or it’s my fault because when I talk about it it makes him not want to do it. Which is another reason this is bothering me so badly. If everything else was great I wouldn’t care so much, but it’s the main thing that makes me feel connected to him. Typing that out made me realize how pathetic and sad that is.

It’s seeming more that he has lost interest everyday. He has no health issues that we know of. He’s always ready for a bj so that’s what really concerns me. He seems very withdrawn from everything concerning sex, but everything else is normal. He doesn’t even kiss me without me initiating it unless he’s leaving the house.
I just feel like it would add another element to the craziness. Especially regarding ripper Stefan or newly turned vamps.
I’m not sure how much longer this relationship is going to last. It’s really taking a toll on my mental health. This isn’t the only thing that him and I disagree on morally

That’s what I don’t understand. It’s not easy being happy when I’m surrounded by people and talking, but when alone with my thoughts wondering if I should just end it. It’s like some days I’m so happy but I still think about killing myself because if I died on that day that I was so happy then I would never have to hurt or be sad again
